title: Stream AI answers over a WebSocket
prompt: Add an AI assistant over a WebSocket. Create src/routes/assistant.ts with `export const assistant`: a WebSocket route at /assistant for signed-in users. Each message is { question } (a string of 1 to 2000 characters). For each question, stream the answer of the "fast" AI model alias to the client as it is generated, with usage tracked for the signed-in user. Register the routes module in src/app.ts.
